Pyre]] }} '''You Can Fight Day or Night With Lunatone & Solrock''' (Japanese: '''VS ルナトーン & ソルロック''' ''VS Lunatone & Solrock''), titled '''VS Lunatone & Solrock''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 229th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 49th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''The Two Orbs''' (Japanese: '''ふたつの宝珠''' ''The Two Jewels'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Two Jewels''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The chapter begins with the legend of {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}, describing how their feud ravaged the world until the Red and Blue Orbs brought it to an end, and the two Pokémon vanished into the depths of the sea, never to be seen again. Atop [[Mt. Pyre]], an old woman tells her husband that enemies have invaded the mountain and [[Tate and Liza]] are fighting them. Although worried that the twins are too young to take the responsibility off their hands, the old couple vow to protect the Orbs no matter the cost. Back at Tate and Liza's location, the twins continue to face the {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s in a [[Double Battle]]. By boosting their stats with {{m|Cosmic Power}} in addition to the {{type|Rock}} that their Pokémon have, the twins gains a huge advantage in the fight. Tate and Liza continue to attack their foes with powerful moves that can hit both targets, which begins to whittle their opponents down. Liza begins bragging and tells her foes to leave, only to start staggering because of the intense heat. Suddenly, their foes rise up again, signifying that they haven't decided to give up. As Tate and Liza continue to battle their foes, [[Blaise]] watches from above. Blaise reveals that the {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s the twins are fighting are only illusions he created with the heat. Tate and Liza are completely fooled, and they continue to wonder why their attacks aren't hitting. As the two fight something that isn't there, Blaise goes to search for the Red and Blue Orbs. Using the [[Scanner]], Blaise finds the old couple and easily swats them away. He picks the two gems from their pedestals, confident over his victory. ==Major events== * [[Tate and Liza]] continue to fight the {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s. * [[Blaise]] reveals that Tate and Liza are only fighting illusions. * Blaise steals the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Chimecho}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Tate and Liza]] * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s (illusion) * Old couple ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Solrock}} ({{OP|Tate|Solrock}}) * {{p|Lunatone}} ({{OP|Liza|Lunatone}}) * {{p|Slugma}} ([[Blaise]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Chimecho}} (Old couple's; ×2) * {{p|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}; fantasy) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 月石&太陽岩|VS Lunatone & Solrock}} (Taiwan)
